description: Writes one sanitized AutoPilot proof event to the tenant ledger. Use this for claim, check, merge, close, proof, and blocker receipts before claiming zero-touch proof.

actor_agent_id.description: Automation seat or App identity that performed the action.

event_type.description: Typed ledger event. Use proof_result for check results and todo_state_change for close.

payload.description: Non-secret proof details. Secret-looking keys or values are rejected by the API.

ref_id.description: Stable object id, such as a PR number, todo UUID, dispatch id, or run id.

ref_kind.description: Stable object type this event proves.

name: autopilot_record_event
title: Record AutoPilot ledger event
